exhibitions_entry.name: MAK – Museum of Applied Arts
exhibitions_entry.description: Vienna's museum of applied arts on the Stubenring, holding one of the world's great graphic collections — Secession-era posters, Wiener Werkstätte design drawings by Josef Hoffmann and Koloman Moser, and a major ukiyo-e print holding.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 빈 슈투벤링에 자리한 응용미술 전문 미술관. 요제프 호프만과 콜로만 모저의 빈 공방 도안, 세기말 포스터, 우키요에 판화까지 그래픽 컬렉션의 깊이로 손꼽히는 곳이다.
